scope: Offline deterministic parity acceptance for normalized capture and replay event sequences.
implemented: Compares ordered normalized-event content hashes before execution; differing inputs are durably reported as non-equivalent.
Runs identical capture and replay inputs through the same ForwardSessionRunner contract in isolated temporary journals.
Hashes the decision with visible event IDs and hashes the durable paper-intent record; parity requires both signal and intent hashes to match.
Parity audit records are idempotent and the runner has no physical broker-order path.

tests.result: 29 passed (exit code 0); Ruff and mypy passed for capture_replay.py.

limitations: The harness accepts event sequences from its caller; caller must read captured and replayed data through the rights-gated local archive.
Synthetic fixtures prove deterministic parity mechanics only; no live session or profitability evidence is claimed.
